name: discord_send_message
description: POSTS IN PUBLIC: send a message to a channel. Returns the created message, whose `id` is what discord_edit_message, discord_delete_message and discord_add_reaction take. Mentions never notify anyone: @everyone, @here and role pings are rendered as text. If this call fails, read the error and stop — do not call it again, or the same message lands twice.

channel_id.description: Discord channel id, e.g. '1180000000000000000'. Right-click the channel -> Copy Channel ID (Developer Mode on), or use discord_list_channels.

content.description: The message text, up to 2000 characters. Markdown works: **bold**, `code`, ```blocks```, <https://links.without.preview>.

reply_to.description: Message id to reply to, making this a threaded reply in the channel.

thread_name.description: Only for forum channels (type 15): the title of the post to create.
